issues.title: Skip pure-optional ConjunctionAnd scan filters (zonemap-only) in the per-row filter loop
issues.hypothesis: Live `dbe-tool profile q19.m0` shows the lineitem TABLE_SCAN carrying `optional: l_shipmode IN (...) AND optional: l_shipmode IN (...)`: a CONJUNCTION_AND whose children are both plain OptionalFilter (zonemap-only, never removes rows; the real shipmode check is the FILTER above the scan, 82,782 -> 11,797 rows). RowGroup::CheckZonemap (row_group.cpp:626) only marks a filter always-true when its top-level type is OPTIONAL_FILTER, so this AND is evaluated per vector: ColumnData::Filter fully decodes l_shipmode (Dictionary VARCHAR) for all ~60M rows and runs no-op OptionalFilter::FilterSelection twice. Because the column counts as a filter column (column_has_filter), it never takes the cheap Select path (row_group.cpp:809-819), which would fetch only the ~83k surviving rows. E0003 measured a pass-everything filter on a Dictionary column at ~0.46s of ~2.7s cumulative scan time, so this pure overhead is roughly 10-15% of the dominant operator (scan 5.84s cumulative of 0.616s total in the profile).
issues.plan: In src/storage/table/row_group.cpp RowGroup::CheckZonemap: add a static helper IsZonemapOnlyFilter(const TableFilter &f) that returns true when f is OPTIONAL_FILTER and NOT a SelectivityOptionalFilter (src/include/duckdb/planner/filter/selectivity_optional_filter.hpp, a final subclass with the same filter_type that DOES filter rows: BF and min/max dynamic join filters). Tell them apart with dynamic_cast/typeid, or with a small virtual on OptionalFilter (e.g. `virtual bool IsZonemapOnly() const { return true; }`, overridden to false in SelectivityOptionalFilter). It also returns true when f is CONJUNCTION_AND and every child satisfies it (recursively). Replace the `filter.filter_type == OPTIONAL_FILTER` test at line 626 with `filter.filter_type == OPTIONAL_FILTER || IsZonemapOnlyFilter(filter)`, keeping the existing behaviour for a top-level OPTIONAL_FILTER exactly as is. Zonemap pruning via CheckZonemap still runs first (line 622), so row-group pruning is unchanged. SetFilterAlwaysTrue already clears column_has_filter, so the column moves to the Select path automatically. Verify: the profile/EXPLAIN still shows the filter; bench q19; check that a query with a l_partkey dynamic AND (BF) still filters (the scan output row count stays at ~83k, not 15M).
issues.expected_gain: q19 ~5-12% (removes a full decode of one Dictionary VARCHAR column and two no-op filter passes per vector over 60M rows in the dominant scan)
issues.generality: Any scan where pushdown produces an AND of optional (zonemap-only) filters on one column, e.g. IN lists or OR-of-equalities pushed as optional, or duplicated pushdowns from derived OR filters (JoinDependentFilterRule). Correctness is unaffected: OptionalFilter never removes rows, and the original predicate is always kept in a FILTER above the scan. Nothing should get slower; the only behaviour change is skipping no-op per-row work.
issues.risk: Low. The main risk is accidentally classifying SelectivityOptionalFilter (BF/min-max) as zonemap-only. That would not give wrong results (the join re-checks keys) but would lose the join-filter speedup. Guard it explicitly and check that the q19 scan output row count is unchanged.

dispatch: Skip pure-optional ConjunctionAnd scan filters (zonemap-only) in the per-row filter loop
output.memory:
# Memory

## Round 1 (gen 1) findings
- q19 is the only visible template (TPC-H Q19 shape: OR of 3 branches, each with join eq + part preds + lineitem preds). Baseline ~307ms hot.
- E0001 ACCEPTED (-46%): JoinDependentFilterRule (src/optimizer/rule/join_dependent_filter.cpp) only fires on ROOT OR; DistributivityRule factored the join eq out first. Fixed by reordering in optimizer.cpp.
- ExpressionRewriter::ApplyRules: is_root=true only on top call from VisitExpression. Rewriter runs once per optimization.
- dbe-tool sql: no shell loops/variables (blocked). Multiple statements separated by ';' inside ONE dbe-tool sql call run in one process (warm-ish) -> best way to A/B isolated predicates. Separate calls are cold and noisy (2x variance).
- bench noise: ~±10% between runs. Need >~10% or repeated runs.

## Round 2 (gen 1)
- E0002 ACCEPTED (-38%): l_quantity OR-of-ranges is an EXPRESSION_FILTER (not ConjunctionOr). Dense mask eval + gather in column_segment.cpp TryDenseFilterSelection.
- Scan filter loop: RowGroup::Scan (row_group.cpp ~760-820) applies filters in AdaptiveFilter permutation order; filter columns are fully decoded (ColumnData::Filter = Scan + FilterSelection) regardless of sel sparsity; other cols use Select (only selected rows). SetFilterAlwaysTrue clears column_has_filter -> column moves to Select path.
- BFTableFilter (planner/filter/bloom_filter.cpp): blocked BF, 12 bits/key, hashes only selected rows.

## Round 3 (gen 1)
- E0003 RETIRED (0%): dictionary-level filter for plain Dictionary VARCHAR. String compares cheap; cost is per-vector scan overhead (a pass-all dict filter ~0.46s cum).
- Storage: l_shipinstruct/l_shipmode = VARCHAR Dictionary; l_partkey/l_quantity BitPacking (no select/filter callbacks). Sparse BitPacking select = 0%.

## Round 4 (gen 1) - best 149.7ms q19 (2.996x)
- E0004 RETIRED: AND-of-optional shipmode filter wasn't present then. Always check the live `dbe-tool profile` before planning.
- SelectivityOptionalFilter (BF + min/max dynamic filters) subclasses OptionalFilter with the same filter_type but DOES filter.

## Round 5 (gen 1)
- E0005 RETIRED (bench noise): cost-aware BF ordering cut scan cum 5.88->4.70s in the profile but no bench wall gain. Ordering is not the bottleneck.
- Latent bug: ExpressionHeuristics::Cost(Expression&) BOUND_REF casts to BoundColumnRefExpression (throws).

## Round 6 (gen 1)
- Live q19.m0 profile NOW shows `optional: l_shipmode IN AND optional: l_shipmode IN` (a ConjunctionAnd of two plain optionals) on the lineitem scan. CheckZonemap (row_group.cpp:626) only skips top-level OPTIONAL_FILTER -> the AND is decoded and evaluated per row for no effect.
- Dispatched: treat a pure-optional AND (excluding SelectivityOptionalFilter) as always-true in CheckZonemap.
- Profile: lineitem scan 82,782 rows out, FILTER shipmode above -> 11,797; part scan+filter ~0.15s cum; join 0.01s.

## Next ideas
- If the skip lands: find/dedupe the source of the duplicated optional pushdown (likely the derived OR filter plus the original both pushed via FilterCombiner).
- Apply the shipmode IN inside the scan as a real filter (drop the FILTER above, 0.15s cum) - needs the optional-filter policy changed.
- Exact bitmap instead of BF for small dense integer build-key ranges.
- ConjunctionOr-of-And TableFilters for OR-of-ranges => zonemap pruning (riskier; quantity is not clustered).
